headword: {抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}

definitions.explanation: A type of medication used to treat bacterial infections by killing or inhibiting the growth of bacteria.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧きって⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the full course of antibiotics.

examples.japanese: {抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧すぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耐性菌|たいせいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}む→生む：29531_umu⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Overuse of antibiotics is a cause of antibiotic-resistant bacteria.

notes:
USAGE:
{抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ} is the formal/technical term for antibiotics. In everyday conversation, people often simply say {抗生剤|こうせいざい} or informally refer to them as their specific medication name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to take antibiotics)
- {抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to prescribe antibiotics)
- {抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}⟦{耐性|たいせい}→耐性：13917_taisei⟧ (antibiotic resistance)

IMPORTANT DISTINCTION:
Antibiotics treat bacterial infections, not viral ones. Japanese doctors sometimes explain this as {抗生物質|こうせいぶっしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{効|き}かない→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (antibiotics don't work for colds).
